retained__g0.75.note: Conditional on inspected gain candidates and existing development profiles; no correction for selecting the best g0. VOC20/VOC21 use paired shared image resamples. Other domains resampled independently.

retained__equal_mean.note: Conditional on inspected gain candidates and existing development profiles; no correction for selecting the best g0. VOC20/VOC21 use paired shared image resamples. Other domains resampled independently.

interpretation: Best values are development selections, not independent-test estimates. LODO only holds out g0 selection: aliases, calibration and other frozen task settings previously used labels. VOC20/VOC21 share images.
averaging: Equal-protocol mean of aggregate dataset mIoU; never mean image IoU.
gain_tie_break: Smallest gain in the ascending frozen menu.
